deliverables.title: Labs
deliverables.notes: 10 weekly labs (weeks of Jan 12–16 through Mar 23–27, skipping reading week Feb 14–22). Each lab worth 1%; lowest 2 dropped (effective series total 8%). Must attend scheduled section, complete work during the session, and submit specified files on OWL within 24 hours. Labs are generally pass/fail.

deliverables.title: Midterm Test
deliverables.notes: Tentatively scheduled Saturday, February 28, 5–7 pm. Locations announced on OWL. 2 hours; combination of Multiple Choice, Written/Drawn Answers, and Algorithm Design; written on paper. No electronic devices allowed. No make-up midterm; if missed with approved academic consideration, weight shifts to final exam (making it worth 60%).
